name: Claydle
source:
Claydle is a demon of Annwn. He is a very cold-blooded person and a sadist who enjoys blood. In addition, he also has strong destructive magic power, and because of such even other demons tend to keep their distance from him. He is not the type to take interest in romance; unless, of course, he finds himself a willing masochistic submissive...
